cards.scene: 工作职业 · Work and Jobs
cards.example_en: Without funding, the drama club could not rent costumes.
cards.example_zh: 没有经费，戏剧社团就租不起服装。

cards.scene: 工作职业 · Work and Jobs
cards.example_en: Central heating keeps the classrooms warm through winter.
cards.example_zh: 集中供暖让教室整个冬天都保持暖和。

cards.scene: 工作职业 · Work and Jobs
cards.example_en: The team meeting ended early because the coach was ill.
cards.example_zh: 教练病了，所以队会提前结束了。

cards.scene: 工作职业 · Work and Jobs
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：犯罪的
cards.example_en: Criminal damage to the lockers was reported before lunch.
cards.example_zh: 午饭前，有人报告储物柜被人故意破坏了。

cards.scene: 工作职业 · Work and Jobs
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：腐烂的
cards.example_en: Throw away the rotten apple before it spoils the others.
cards.example_zh: 把腐烂的苹果扔掉，免得弄坏其他水果。

cards.scene: 工作职业 · Work and Jobs
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：职业生涯
cards.example_en: She wants a career in medicine.

cards.scene: 工作职业 · Work and Jobs
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：驾驶员
cards.example_en: The driver stopped the bus so a student could pick up her folder.
cards.example_zh: 司机把车停下，让一名学生捡起她的文件夹。

cards.scene: 工作职业 · Work and Jobs
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：复活节
cards.example_en: We hid chocolate eggs in the garden for the Easter treasure hunt.
cards.example_zh: 我们把巧克力蛋藏在花园里，做复活节寻宝游戏。

cards.scene: 工作职业 · Work and Jobs
cards.example_en: Her employer let her start late on the morning of the exam.
cards.example_zh: 考试那天早上，雇主让她晚一点来上班。

cards.scene: 工作职业 · Work and Jobs
cards.example_en: The farmer let our class pick strawberries if we left the small ones.
cards.example_zh: 农民让我们班摘草莓，但小的要留下。

cards.scene: 工作职业 · Work and Jobs
cards.example_en: Our neighbour works as a lawyer in the city court.
cards.example_zh: 我们的邻居在市法院当律师。

cards.scene: 工作职业 · Work and Jobs
cards.example_en: Spread a thin layer of butter on the warm toast.
cards.example_zh: 在热烤面包上涂一薄层黄油。

cards.scene: 工作职业 · Work and Jobs
cards.example_en: The shop manager gave us a discount on the team shirts.
cards.example_zh: 商店经理给我们的队服打了折。

cards.scene: 工作职业 · Work and Jobs
cards.example_en: He greeted the guests in a friendly manner at the door.
cards.example_zh: 他在门口以友好的样子迎接客人。

cards.scene: 工作职业 · Work and Jobs
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：研究员
cards.example_en: The researcher asked how many hours we sleep at night.
cards.example_zh: 研究员问我们夜里睡几个小时。
